name: Daura

span.note: The Bayajidda legend has no firm date.

summary.text: Daura is the "mother" of the Hausa states in the Bayajidda legend: a stranger kills the snake in the town well and marries Queen Daurama, and their descendants found the seven Hausa kingdoms. It became a Fulani emirate in the jihad, while the old line moved to Zango.

ruler.title: Sarkin Daura (in legend, a line of queens)

snapshots.title: Queen Daurama and Bayajidda
snapshots.text: The founding legend of the Hausa states is set in Daura. The well where Bayajidda killed the snake, Kusugu, is still shown in the town.

snapshots.title: The jihad reaches Daura
snapshots.text: A Fulani emir takes Daura. The Hausa dynasty withdraws east and rules from Zango; after colonial rule the line returned to Daura.

today.text: The Emir of Daura reigns in Daura, Katsina State.
today.title: Emir of Daura
